why: EKBLOOM is developed concurrently by another process and its working tree is not reproducible. Pinning to an immutable git revision makes every OrFS build fetch exactly the committed EKBLOOM source at rev 255452e, independent of any uncommitted edits in that working tree.

working_tree_at_pin_time.head: 255452e1a803080de99f7a18aaef840c8c835209
working_tree_at_pin_time.note: The uncommitted edits are additive (new authenticated-read APIs); the pinned revision contains every item OrFS depends on.

container_git: git added to Dockerfile and Dockerfile.kmount (rust:1.99.0-slim-bookworm ships none); Cargo requires it to fetch the rev-pinned git dependency.
